title: Operator Administration Without SQL
objective: Authorized Oxford Lancers administrators can provision and manage application operators and their predefined role assignments through the application without requiring Brian to run SQL or make ordinary account changes directly in Supabase.
why_now: The authorization substrate, login and password recovery exist, but the hosted role catalogue and recurring operator-administration workflow are not available through the application. The approved Release 1 manifest marks Identity, Access and Operator Administration ready for intake, while current operation still depends on direct database changes.
non_goals: No capability-map editing through the application
No new club roles, renamed roles, editable grants or changed capability semantics beyond reconciling the operator-administration authority approved during intake
No wider H7 ownership and access completion sweep
No LAN-84 production recovery rehearsal or two-service-administrator establishment
No Meta, WhatsApp, DNS, email-foundation or real-data cutover work
No player-facing accounts or public sign-up
No authentication-architecture redesign or operator two-factor authentication
No unrelated People, roster, coaching, season-lifecycle or committee-handoff capability
No special bulk handover mode or cycle-open/close implementation
No full Stage-4 change-audit viewing interface or general audit browser
No Mission Lead DAG, worker assignment, detailed work package or implementation sequencing in this packet
No mission execution before Brian merges a ready packet version

requirements.text: The application uses the approved static 13-seat role catalogue exactly as defined; the catalogue is available in hosted and local environments through versioned, reviewable repository artifacts, and the application cannot edit role definitions or capability grants.

Every operator-administration read and write is enforced at the server/service boundary by the frozen role_management capability, granted only to President and General Manager. Vice-President and Secretary retain their approved operating capabilities but cannot invite, deactivate, re-home or administer operator accounts, and cannot assign, end or replace role assignments.

The operator shell contains real Operators and Roles destinations at /operate/admin/operators and /operate/admin/roles. Administration is placed at the bottom of the left sidebar, separated from regular operating destinations and immediately above the user/account controls. Authorized President and General Manager operators can understand current account status, current effective assignments, cycle scope and current role holders without SQL; unauthorized users receive no operator data.

An authorized administrator can select an existing durable Person, provide an invitation email, optionally assign approved initial roles, create and bind the operator login one-to-one, and send the invitation. The workflow never creates a Person and public sign-up remains disabled.

The workflow represents Invited, Active, Deactivated and Reinstated states, treats expiration as a normal state, permits resend while Invited, and refuses duplicate Person bindings or duplicate emails with an actionable reason.

Every role assignment selects exactly one existing open cycle matching the role scope: committee year for committee seats and season for coaching seats. Missing, closed or scope-mismatched cycles are refused with the reason stated; the cycle is never silently inferred.

Assigning a role records its effective-from date. Ending or replacing it sets effective-to and creates the new assignment without deleting or rewriting prior assignments. Constitutional-office overlap constraints remain enforced.

An authorized administrator can deactivate an operator with a required reason and date, and reinstate the same Person-account binding later. Deactivation immediately prevents sign-in and never deletes the Person, account binding, attribution or historical records.

For lost email access, an authorized administrator can re-home an operator login to a new email, disable the old login path, and preserve audited attribution on both sides. Forgotten-password recovery remains self-service and is not replaced by administrator password handling.

No operator may deactivate their own account or end/remove their own President or General Manager assignment through the ordinary workflow, even when another administrator exists. President and General Manager administer one another's top-level access. No deactivation or role end-dating may leave zero active operators with an effective role_management-bearing assignment. Imminent continuity risk is visible when every effective role_management assignment ends within 30 days.

Every provisioning, account-state, email-rehome and role-assignment change writes append-only audit evidence in the same transaction, naming actor, target, time and before/after state. The mission verifies this evidence and historical resolvability but does not build the later general change-audit viewing interface.

Exactly one owner-run bootstrap may establish the hosted role catalogue and first administrator-capable operator. It is reviewable, fail-closed, documented and audited. After bootstrap, every ordinary identity, access and role action is completed in the application; a second SQL-based administration touch is a defect.

A short club-facing guide explains the in-application invite, first-login, current-state, assignment, cycle-selection, role-ending, deactivation, reinstatement and email-rehome workflows, along with refusals and when to escalate. It does not instruct club operators to use SQL, Supabase or a nonexistent full audit viewer.

Implementation and verification do not alter hosted accounts, production data, secrets, email/DNS configuration or recovery ownership autonomously. Any migration or one-time hosted bootstrap remains an explicit Brian-run handoff under existing runbooks.

President and General Manager may assign people to the approved static role catalogue, including roles that currently carry no privileged capabilities. They cannot create roles or edit grants in the application. Role definitions and capability grants remain reviewed product-and-code changes, not runtime administration.

decisions.text: No split. Provisioning, operator lifecycle, role assignment, current-state surfaces, safeguards and the short operating guide form one coherent commissioned outcome.
decisions.source: Commissioned outcome and Mission Intake Agent rare-splitting rule

decisions.text: Reopened for owner resolution during active intake: append-only provisioning and role audit evidence is mandatory and the later full general audit browser remains excluded. Brian must decide whether this mission also includes a narrow, read-only access-history view on an operator detail page for mission-owned changes, or preserves evidence only for a later viewing interface.
decisions.source: Commissioned audit-boundary question; Identity, Access & Ownership brief §2 versus §3/D-5; Brian intake review 2026-08-18

decisions.text: Locked: authorized provisioning and role actions are single-actor and take effect immediately; there is no second-confirmation workflow.
Locked: Person, operator account and role assignment remain separate durable concepts. Roles are relationships and player status remains a seasonal membership, not an account type.
decisions.source: Identity, Access & Ownership brief §§2.3 and 3.2; LAN-71

decisions.text: Locked: the role catalogue and capability map are read-only in the application. Changing a role or grant remains a separately reviewed owner decision and code change.

Locked by Brian during intake on 2026-08-18: only President and General Manager hold recurring operator- and role-administration authority. Vice-President and Secretary retain broad ordinary operating authority but do not invite or administer operators and do not assign or remove roles. The prior four-role Notion grant and IT-Officer-only implementation must be reconciled deliberately.
decisions.source: Brian intake decision, 2026-08-18, superseding Identity, Access & Ownership brief D-2 for this mission

decisions.text: Locked by Brian during intake on 2026-08-18: Administration is a low-frequency privileged area at the bottom of the left application sidebar, separated from Events, Calendar, Roster and other ordinary operations and positioned immediately above user/account controls.

Locked by Brian during intake on 2026-08-18: President and General Manager are the top-level application administrators; Secretary and Vice-President share the broad ordinary operating tier. This mission changes only mission-relevant operator/role administration and does not silently re-author every unrelated capability.

Locked by Brian during intake on 2026-08-18: President and General Manager cannot deactivate themselves or end/remove their own top-level assignment through the ordinary application workflow. Each administers the other's transition; total lockout recovery remains the separately governed service-administrator process.

Proposed for owner approval: the Roles page may show a read-only plain-language summary of the capabilities carried by each predefined role so President and General Manager can understand the consequence of an assignment. Editing roles or grants remains excluded.
decisions.source: Brian intake question 2026-08-18; Identity, Access & Ownership brief §2.6 and Stage-4 §3

repository_drift.startup_rule: The Mission Lead must compare current main to the baseline and run the canonical Harness drift checks before planning or dispatch. A newer main is acceptable only when the packet's meaning, feasibility, invariants, interfaces and acceptance basis remain intact.
repository_drift.stop_rule: Stop for re-intake or a versioned packet revision when drift changes authorization, operator/account/role schema semantics, audit guarantees, route placement, security boundaries or acceptance evidence.

Brian provides visual approval for UI-affecting implementation packages through the Mission Harness review-ready flow

workflow_matrix.trigger: Needs to inspect or manage operator access
workflow_matrix.entry_point: Administration at the bottom of the operator shell left sidebar
actions: Open an operator or role detail
handoffs: Choose the account-side or role-side path for the same audited assignment action
exceptions: Vice-President, Secretary and all other roles cannot read operator-administration data or invoke its actions
No operators shows the empty state with Invite
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: Current account status, effective roles, cycle scope and current holders are understandable without SQL

workflow_matrix.trigger: An existing Person needs application access
actions: Optionally select initial approved roles and explicit cycles
state_transitions: Invited to Active after first sign-in/password setup
exceptions: Transport failure is visible and retryable
Person creation routes back to People/roster scope
A person who does not yet exist must first use the separately owned People creation path; invitation never fabricates a Person
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: The Person is bound one-to-one to an invited operator account and any valid initial roles are effective as dated

workflow_matrix.trigger: A predefined office or coaching seat changes holder
actions: Confirm the matching active cycle under the owner-approved cycle-context interaction
End with effective-to when the appointment actually ends
Use the replacement action for a successor without rewriting history
state_transitions: Ended assignment plus new effective assignment
handoffs: The same service action is invoked from either direction
exceptions: President or General Manager attempts to remove their own top-level assignment
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: Current assignment changes immediately while prior effective-dated facts remain durable

workflow_matrix.trigger: An operator leaves, loses access or returns
handoffs: Deactivated person remains resolvable to historical records
exceptions: President or General Manager self-removal refused
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: Sign-in access ends or resumes without deleting the Person, binding or history

workflow_matrix.trigger: An operator permanently loses access to the current email address
state_transitions: Same operator binding reachable at new email
handoffs: Operator signs in or recovers password using the new email
exceptions: Ordinary forgotten password routes to self-service recovery
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: Access is restored without changing the durable Person or historical actor attribution

workflow_matrix.actor: System on behalf of the authorized administrator
workflow_matrix.trigger: Any mission-owned provisioning or role transition succeeds
workflow_matrix.placement: No general audit-view route in this mission
actions: Commit audit and state change atomically
state_transitions: Append one immutable audit event; never edit or delete prior evidence
handoffs: Evidence is available to later Stage-4 audit-view work
exceptions: A failed/refused action writes no partial state
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: The action succeeds or fails atomically; current state is visible, while full audit browsing remains deferred

workflow_matrix.actor: President or General Manager with an effective assignment
workflow_matrix.trigger: Attempt to open or use administration surfaces
workflow_matrix.entry_point: Every administration page, action and service call
workflow_matrix.user_visible_result: Only the President and General Manager may administer application operators and role assignments; every other account is refused without operator data

nonblocking_unknowns.unknown: LAN-126 may not yet provide production-grade invitation email deliverability.
nonblocking_unknowns.handling: Do not absorb DNS, Resend or SMTP work. Build against the existing provider-neutral auth invitation path, prove behavior locally and surface delivery failure. Production activation follows the existing external gate.

nonblocking_unknowns.unknown: Cycle open/close administration is not yet implemented.
nonblocking_unknowns.handling: Assignments may use only cycles that already exist and are open. Missing/closed cycles are refused. Creating cycles remains season-lifecycle scope.

Defect fixes that restore the packet's locked behavior without changing scope

Automated authorization tests cover President and General Manager as permitted administrators; Vice-President, Secretary, IT Officer and other roles as refused administrators; plus unlinked, inactive, direct-action, self-removal and final-administrator refusal cases
Automated lifecycle tests cover invite, first activation, resend/expiry, duplicate guards, deactivation, reinstatement and email re-home without deleting the Person or attribution
Database/service tests prove explicit cycle scope, constitutional-office constraints, effective-dated history and atomic append-only audit evidence
UI tests and Brian's live visual review cover desktop and 375px Operators and Roles pages, empty/loading/error/refusal states and every consequential action placement
A local end-to-end walkthrough completes ordinary operator administration without SQL or Supabase dashboard changes
The club-facing operating guide is executable as written and contains no SQL, Supabase or full-audit-view dependency
The pull-request production handoff names any schema migration and the exact one-time Brian-run bootstrap; no agent performs hosted changes
blockers: Authoritative reconciliation: the owner-approved Identity, Access & Ownership brief D-2 still grants role_management to President, Vice-President, Secretary and General Manager, while Brian's 2026-08-18 intake decision narrows it to President and General Manager. The reusable product record requires an explicitly approved surgical correction before this packet becomes ready.

Audit visibility: decide whether this mission adds a narrow read-only operator access-history panel for mission-owned events, or preserves and verifies evidence only while leaving all viewing to the later Stage-4 audit interface. The full general audit browser remains excluded either way.

Cycle interaction: reconcile the commissioned no-silent-inference invariant with Brian's direction that administrators work inside the active 2026-27 operating context rather than manually choosing a cycle on every assignment.

Role cardinality: confirm whether General Manager is a single-holder top-level role and whether the existing rule remains one holder for constitutional offices but multiple holders for non-constitutional seats.

Permission transparency: decide whether this mission's Roles page shows a read-only plain-language summary of each predefined role's capabilities, or whether capability visibility remains limited to the controlling brief/code until the later Stage-4 catalogue enhancement. Editing grants remains excluded.

approval.evidence: Not approved. Brian narrowed operator and role administration to President and General Manager and locked sidebar placement and no-self-removal during intake on 2026-08-18. Audit visibility, permission transparency, cycle interaction, role cardinality and the required authoritative reconciliation remain open; Brian's later merge of a ready packet-only PR approves the exact version and commit.
